cfg = json.loads(read('renovate.json'))
src = read('versions.toml')
for m in cfg['regexManagers']:
    for ms in m['matchStrings']:
        rx = re.compile(ms)
        found = False
        for line in src.splitlines():
            mt = rx.search(line)
            if mt and 'currentValue' in mt.groupdict():
                found = True
                print(f"matchString: {ms!r}")
                print(f"  line: {line.strip()}")
                print(f"  currentValue={mt['currentValue']!r} -> dep {m['depNameTemplate']} ({m['datasourceTemplate']})")

                print(f"  versioning: {m['versioningTemplate']}")
        if not found:
            print(f"NO MATCH for {ms!r}")
        print()

content.text:
Renovate isn't running against this repo at all — the config is fine, the bot has never executed here.

## Evidence

**The config works** (verified against `versions.toml`):
- `smolvm_golden_version` regex manager matches `smolvm_golden_version = "1.8.2"` → dep `smol-machines/smolvm`, `github-releases`, semver. Same for `runner_version` → `actions/runner`.
- Both are pinned correctly, and the pin is stale: smolvm shipped **11 stable releases** since `1.8.2` (v1.8.3 → v1.13.1, latest 2026-08-27). A running Renovate would have opened a bump PR to v1.13.1.

**Renovate has never created anything in `preloopdev/preloop`**:
- `gh pr list --author app/renovate` → **zero** PRs. No onboarding PR, no bump PRs.
- No "Dependency Dashboard" issue exists (it's created on the first run that finds updates).
- No self-hosted Renovate anywhere: no workflow in `.github/workflows/`, no local binary/cron/launchd/docker container.

**Repo is org-owned**: `preloopdev` org created 2026-06-26; the Renovate config landed 2026-08-11 (commits `c5b80084`/`f4d7d940`) — after the org move.

## Diagnosis

The **Renovate GitHub App is not installed on the `preloopdev` org** — the account that owns the repo. The `renovate.json`, `smolvm-release-verify.yml`, and `runner-sync.yml` tripwire wiring are all inert without it. If the app were installed (or ever ran), we'd see at minimum the Dependency Dashboard issue; there's no trace of any run. [Direct install status isn't queryable with the current token — the 401/403 from the installation endpoints is a token limitation, so this is inferred from the total absence of bot activity.]

## Fix (org admin, your action)

1. Go to `github.com/apps/renovate` → **Install** → select the `preloopdev` org → grant repo access to `preloop` (write needed for bump branches/PRs + dashboard issue).
2. Because `renovate.json` already exists, it skips onboarding and starts on its hourly schedule — expect the smolvm bump PR (1.8.2 → 1.13.1) and a Dependency Dashboard issue within the hour, plus the `actions/runner` tripwire PR when upstream moves past 2.336.0.

Caveat from your own config comment: the smolvm auto-merge waits for `smolvm-release-verify.yml`, which is inert until `SMOLVM_VERIFY_HOST_WORKSPACE` is set and a `[self-hosted, smolvm-host]` runner is registered — don't trust auto-merge before that exists.

content.text:
Since the pin (`1.8.2`, 2026-08-15) smolvm shipped **12 releases** (v1.8.3 → v1.13.1, all stable). Grouped by theme, with the release each landed in:

## Networking
- **Named inter-VM networks** with routed addressing between machines (1.8.3)
- `host.smolvm.internal` resolves to the gateway; default `/etc/hosts` when the image ships none (1.8.3)
- Loopback proxy host rewritten to the host's outbound address so guests can reach it (1.12.0)
- Guest IPv6 gated on real host reachability, resolver defaulted **IPv4-first** (1.10.1)
- libkrunfw guest kernel with **IPv4/IPv6 policy routing** — TUN-based VPN/proxy clients work (1.10.1)
- Guest TCP FIN forwarded properly in the virtio-net relay (1.8.3)

## Remote volumes / S3
- `--volume` can mount **S3 and any rclone remote** (1.10.0/1.10.1); agent mounts S3 natively, no rclone needed in the image (1.10.1)
- Remote volumes carried on every exec, on the embedded machine spec (SDK machines), and on ephemeral runs without a persistent overlay (1.11.0/1.11.1)

## Packing / image fidelity
- Default `/etc/hosts` provided (1.8.3); **auto-shrink disk by reclaiming freed blocks to the host** (1.9.0)
- Disk auto-grows an existing storage/overlay to the requested size instead of booting the stale one (1.9.2) — relevant to preloop's storage sizing
- Archive-flatten scratch staged on the storage disk instead of guest tmpfs; damaged layer caches rebuilt from the source artifact (1.9.1/1.9.2)
- Pack-export reads get one consistent ceiling (1.8.3 — yours); pre-1.13 packs extracted host-side when they predate in-guest unpacking (1.13.0)

## Forking / checkpoints
- Forkable golden survives config-change VM restarts; keep-alive container reused for fork-clone exec instead of a fresh container per call (1.9.1)
- **Transactional embedded batch forking**, hardened forked workloads (1.12.0); **nested machine checkpoints** (1.13.0); **portable live checkpoints** and fork checkpoints preserved across runtime restarts (1.13.1)

## GPU / display
- Segmented CUDA graph capture (1.9.0); automatic CUDA replay + distributed multi-GPU (1.9.2)
- Bundled Venus Vulkan driver injected into GPU workload containers; driver pinned only when the container has the bundle; mounted into pod/overlay containers too (1.9.0/1.12.0)
- **Opt-in virtio-gpu scanout + VNC** with virtio-input — interactive Linux desktop; VNC port now serves a browser client (1.12.0/1.13.1)

## Reliability / platform
- Broken blob downloads resume with bound retry instead of hanging machine create (1.10.1)
- Release lookup **fails instead of falling back to hardcoded 0.1.1** (1.13.0); expired registry-token warning instead of bare 401 (1.13.1)
- macOS: `libkrun.dylib` Homebrew refs relocated to `@loader_path` so packed launchers boot (1.9.2); missing hypervisor entitlement named on boot -22 (1.9.0 — yours); net-enabled libkrun restored (1.8.0); aarch64-KVM snapshot + fork support (1.9.2)
- Windows krun.dll rebuilt so machines boot on WHP again (1.10.1)
- Egress policy enforced even when served from the image cache; egress denials recorded per machine (1.9.0/1.8.1)
- cgroup2 controllers delegated at agent boot; unknown fields rejected on exec/run API (1.9.0/1.9.2); h2 bumped to clear RUSTSEC-2026-0258 (1.9.0)

## Worth flagging for preloop
- **1.9.2's `@loader_path` relocation** — `preloop update --ensure-runtime` on macOS installs "latest stable ≥ 1.8.1"; packed-launcher boot was broken before 1.9.2, so the floor's minimum is fine but the runtime floor comment ("first release satisfying all invariants") predates it.
- 1.13.0's fail-fast release lookup is a behavior preloop's `--ensure-runtime` interacts with (no silent 0.1.1 fallback).
- Your own PRs shipped in this window: pack-export read ceiling (1.8.3), macOS entitlement message (1.9.0), flatten EAGAIN window + post-`--` option validation + storage disk grow (1.9.2), mount-socket collision fix (1.8.0).

The renovate bump would go 1.8.2 → **1.13.1**; the smolvm-release-verify E2E gate exists precisely because the disk-grow and egress changes touch preloop's VM lifecycle.

content.text:
The exact root cause was a **schema validation error in `renovate.json`** that caused Renovate to abort every run on this repo before extracting any dependencies or opening PRs.

### Why it failed

Running `renovate-config-validator` and the Renovate engine locally on `renovate.json` caught the exact error:

```text
INFO: Found renovate config errors
  - topic: "Configuration Error"
  - message: "Custom Manager contains disallowed fields: extractVersion"
INFO: Repository has invalid config
  - validationError: "The renovate configuration file contains some invalid settings"
```

1. **`extractVersion` vs `extractVersionTemplate`**: Renovate's regex manager schema requires `extractVersionTemplate`, not `extractVersion`.
2. **`regexManagers` vs `customManagers`**: Renovate migrated `regexManagers` to `customManagers` with `customType: "regex"`.

Because `extractVersion` was rejected as a disallowed field, the Renovate worker failed configuration validation and silently exited without opening any PRs or creating the Dependency Dashboard.

---

### The Fix

`renovate.json` has been updated and validated cleanly (`INFO: Config validated successfully`):

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://docs.renovatebot.com/renovate-schema.json",
  "extends": ["config:recommended"],
  "dependencyDashboard": true,
  "packageRules": [
    {
      "matchDatasources": ["github-releases"],
      "matchDepNames": ["actions/runner", "smol-machines/smolvm"],
      "labels": ["dependencies"]
    },
    {
      "matchDatasources": ["github-releases"],
      "matchDepNames": ["smol-machines/smolvm"],
      "description": "SmolVM bumps auto-merge once ci.yml and the smolvm-release-verify check pass.",
      "automerge": true,
      "automergeType": "pr"
    },
    {
      "matchDatasources": ["github-releases"],
      "matchDepNames": ["actions/runner"],
      "description": "Runner bump PR is the tripwire for the runner-watch pipeline.",
      "labels": ["protocol-sync", "dependencies"]
    }
  ],
  "customManagers": [
    {
      "customType": "regex",
      "description": "Official actions/runner release pin in versions.toml.",
      "fileMatch": ["^versions\\.toml$"],
      "matchStrings": ["runner_version\\s*=\\s*\"(?<currentValue>[^\"]+)\""],
      "depNameTemplate": "actions/runner",
      "datasourceTemplate": "github-releases",
      "versioningTemplate": "semver",
      "extractVersionTemplate": "^v(?<version>.*)$"
    },
    {
      "customType": "regex",
      "description": "SmolVM release the golden workflow builds with.",
      "fileMatch": ["^versions\\.toml$"],
      "matchStrings": ["smolvm_golden_version\\s*=\\s*\"(?<currentValue>[^\"]+)\""],
      "depNameTemplate": "smol-machines/smolvm",
      "datasourceTemplate": "github-releases",
      "versioningTemplate": "semver",
      "extractVersionTemplate": "^v(?<version>.*)$"
    }
  ]
}
```

Once merged to `main`, Renovate's next worker pass will pass validation, generate the **Dependency Dashboard** issue, and open the bump PR for **`smolvm_golden_version` (`1.8.2` $\rightarrow$ `1.13.1`)**.

content.text:
**Yes, exactly.** Renovate acts as the **tripwire** that kicks off the entire official runner synchronization pipeline.

---

### The End-to-End Trigger Flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[New official actions/runner release on GitHub] -->|GitHub Releases datasource| B[Renovate opens PR bumping runner_version in versions.toml]
    B -->|renovate.json applies protocol-sync label & blocks automerge| C[.github/workflows/runner-sync.yml triggered on PR]
    C --> D[prep job: ubuntu-latest]
    D -->|runner-watch diff| E[Calculates source delta from baseline]
    E -->|runner-watch triage| F[Generates protocol specs in .runner-watch/specs/]
    F -->|gh pr comment| G[Posts spec & delta summary directly on Renovate PR]
    D --> H[sync job: runner-sync host]
    H -->|mitmproxy + official runner| I[Captures new protocol wire goldens]
    I -->|runner-watch conform| J[Runs conformance test suite against Preloop]
    J --> K[Opens tiered implementation PRs for protocol deltas]
```

### 1. The Renovate Tripwire (`renovate.json`)
- **Datasource**: Watches `actions/runner` on `github-releases`.
- **Target**: Bumps `runner_version = "..."` in `versions.toml`.
- **Rules**:
  - Sets label: `["protocol-sync", "dependencies"]`.
  - Blocks auto-merge (`automerge: false`) because upstream runner changes require wire golden verification and spec review before adopting.

### 2. The Sync Workflow (`.github/workflows/runner-sync.yml`)
Triggered automatically whenever a PR modifies `versions.toml` (or manually via `workflow_dispatch` with custom `--from` / `--to` tags):

1. **`prep` job** (Runs on `ubuntu-latest`):
   - Compares the upstream runner codebase (`runner-watch diff --from <old> --to <new>`).
   - Parses code changes into protocol specs (`runner-watch triage`).
   - Comments the change summary directly onto Renovate's tripwire PR.
2. **`sync` job** (Runs on `runner-sync` host with `mitmproxy`):
   - Records wire goldens with the real binary.
   - Verifies Preloop's broker and Results Service conformance.
   - Spawns tiered draft PRs on `runner-sync/v<version>` branches for any protocol deltas.

### 1. How the Agent Implementation Works (`runner-watch`)
The agent pipeline is built directly into `crates/runner-watch`:
- **Implementer (`runner-watch implement`)**: Uses `codex exec <prompt>` (configurable via `agents.implement`) to implement each generated protocol spec in `.runner-watch/specs/<version>/`.
  - Runs in a loop up to `max_implement_iterations` (default: 10).
  - Automatically runs `cargo check` and relevant tests after each iteration. If compile/tests fail, it feeds the compiler/test error back into the agent prompt to retry.
  - Automatically commits passing implementations per spec.
- **Reviewer (`runner-watch review`)**: Uses `claude` (configurable via `agents.review`) to review implementation diffs against upstream protocol semantics.

---

### 2. Current Configuration Status in the Repo

| Component | Status | Location / Details |
|---|---|---|
| **Deterministic Triage (`prep` job)** | ✅ **Enabled** | Runs on `ubuntu-latest` (no agents needed); comments spec summary on Renovate PR |
| **Agent Implementation Code** | ✅ **Implemented** | `crates/runner-watch/src/main.rs` (`implement` + `review` commands) |
| **Self-Hosted Runner Host** | ⏸️ **Not Configured** | Needs a self-hosted runner labeled `[self-hosted, runner-sync]` with `mitmproxy` + official runner |
| **`RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE`** | ❌ **Not Set** | Repo variable required for the `sync` job to run |
| **`RUNNER_SYNC_AGENTS`** | ❌ **Not Set** | Repo variable (`RUNNER_SYNC_AGENTS=true`) required to run `implement` and `review` steps |

---

### 3. What happens right now when a runner release drops:
1. Renovate opens the `runner_version` bump PR (`protocol-sync`).
2. The `prep` job runs on `ubuntu-latest`, parses the upstream C# runner delta, creates the protocol specs, and posts a comment on the PR.
3. Because `RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE` and `RUNNER_SYNC_AGENTS` are not set, the workflow produces the spec breakdown for human review and draft PRs rather than dispatching autonomous agents.

To turn on autonomous agent implementations:
1. Register a runner labeled `[self-hosted, runner-sync]` with `codex`, `claude`, and `mitmproxy` installed.
2. Set repository variables:
   - `RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE=/path/to/workspace`
   - `RUNNER_SYNC_AGENTS=true`

content.text:
**Yes, exactly.** The workflow is designed specifically for Preloop's execution model and will run cleanly without queue stalls:

### 1. How Preloop handles `runner-sync.yml`
* **`prep` job (`runs-on: ubuntu-latest`)**:
  * Runs on Preloop's standard Linux microVM runner pool (or GitHub-hosted).
  * Executes the deterministic diff (`runner-watch diff`) and triage (`runner-watch triage --no-agents`).
  * Posts the spec summary comment to Renovate's tripwire PR and attaches the `.runner-watch/specs/**` artifacts.
* **`sync` job (`runs-on: [self-hosted, runner-sync]`)**:
  * Gated with a root-level condition: `if: vars.RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE != ''`.
  * Because Preloop evaluates job-level `if` expressions at workflow submission time, when `RUNNER_SYNC_HOST_WORKSPACE` is unset, Preloop **skips `sync` immediately** rather than letting it sit queued indefinitely waiting for a labeled runner.

### 2. Summary of our workflow states in self-hosted CI

| Workflow | Trigger / Runner | Behavior in Preloop |
|---|---|---|
| **`ci.yml`** | PRs / Main (`runs-on: ubuntu-latest`) | Standard test & lint suite across microVM pool |
| **`smolvm-release-verify.yml`** | Renovate smolvm bumps (`runs-on: [self-hosted, smolvm-host]`) | Active (gated by `SMOLVM_VERIFY_HOST_WORKSPACE=/opt/actions-runner`) |
| **`runner-sync.yml` (`prep`)** | Renovate runner bumps (`runs-on: ubuntu-latest`) | Runs automatically, diffs upstream, and posts specs on the PR |
| **`runner-sync.yml` (`sync`)** | Needs-gated downstream (`runs-on: [self-hosted, runner-sync]`) | Cleanly skipped until a dedicated MITM capture runner is provisioned |
